simetri.extensions.table

Simetri Table for documentation layouts.

Cells may hold plain text or drawable objects (Shape, Group, Lace, and similar). Plain text is rendered as Tag sketches for SVG/PDF export; drawables are sketched inside their cell bounds.

Styling merges in order: table, column, row, cell (later wins). Header cells use table, column, and the column header Cell only.

Notebook preview uses rich.table.Table (Jupyter integration).

Most layout defaults for this extension live in this module. Cell fill defaults use runtime_defaults['table_fill'] and runtime_defaults['header_row_fill'] in config/settings.py (merged before table / column / row / cell layers).

Cell indexing (read this before addressing cells):

  • All indices are 0-based Python integers. There are no letter column labels (no A, B, C coordinates).
  • Columns are always numbered 0, 1, 2, … left to right.
  • Two row conventions exist:
    • Grid row — used by Table.cells, Table.range(), Table.cell(), and table.cells[row, col]. Row 0 is the header when a header row is shown; the next row is 1. With no header, row 0 is the first body row.
    • Data row — used by Table.row(), Table.populate(), and table.rows[i]. Row 0 is the first body row; the header is not counted.
  • Table.columns uses column indices 0, 1, … on the full grid (including the header row in the underlying Range).

  20- **Columns** are always numbered ``0``, ``1``, ``2``, … left to right.
  21- Two row conventions exist:
  22  - **Grid row** — used by :attr:`Table.cells`, :meth:`Table.range`,
  23    :meth:`Table.cell`, and ``table.cells[row, col]``. Row ``0`` is the

 110def _cell_display_text(content: Any) -> str:
 111    """Notebook cell text until drawable cells render as graphics."""
 112    if isinstance(content, SplitCell):
 113        return f"{content.first} {content.kind} {content.second}"
 114    if isinstance(content, str):
 115        return content
 116    if isinstance(content, (int, float, bool)):
 117        return str(content)
 118    try:
 119        cell_type = content.type
 120    except AttributeError:
 121        return str(content)
 122    return f"[{cell_type}]"

 140class SplitCell:
 141    """Two labels in one table cell, separated by a divider.
 142
 143    This is cell *content*, not an unmerge operation. ``kind`` is a divider
 144    character or a ``SplitCell`` class attribute (same strings).
 145
 146    ``"-"`` / ``HORIZONTAL``: ``first`` on top, ``second`` on bottom.
 147    ``"|"`` / ``VERTICAL``: ``first`` on the left, ``second`` on the right.
 148    ``"\\\\"`` / ``DIAGONAL_DOWN``: ``first`` lower-left, ``second`` upper-right.
 149    ``"/"`` / ``DIAGONAL_UP``: ``first`` upper-left, ``second`` lower-right.
 150
 151    ``offset1`` and ``offset2`` are ``(dx, dy)`` added after that default
 152    placement.
 153
 154    Examples:
 155        >>> split = SplitCell(SplitCell.HORIZONTAL, "top", "bottom")
 156        >>> split.kind
 157        '-'
 158        >>> split.second
 159        'bottom'
 160    """
 161
 162    HORIZONTAL = "-"
 163    VERTICAL = "|"
 164    DIAGONAL_UP = "/"
 165    DIAGONAL_DOWN = "\\"
 166
 167    def __init__(
 168        self,
 169        kind: str,
 170        first: str,
 171        second: str,
 172        offset1: PointType = (0.0, 0.0),
 173        offset2: PointType = (0.0, 0.0),
 174    ) -> None:
 175        if kind not in _SPLIT_CELL_KINDS:
 176            raise ValueError(
 177                f"SplitCell kind must be one of {sorted(_SPLIT_CELL_KINDS)}"
 178            )
 179        self.kind = kind
 180        self.first = first
 181        self.second = second
 182        self.offset1 = offset1
 183        self.offset2 = offset2
 184
 185
 186_SPLIT_CELL_KINDS = frozenset(
 187    {
 188        SplitCell.DIAGONAL_DOWN,
 189        SplitCell.DIAGONAL_UP,
 190        SplitCell.HORIZONTAL,
 191        SplitCell.VERTICAL,
 192    }
 193)

 196class Cell:
 197    """One table cell: content plus local format and background overrides.
 198
 199    Examples:
 200        >>> cell = Cell("value")
 201        >>> cell.content
 202        'value'
 203    """
 204
 205    def __init__(self, content: Any = "") -> None:
 206        """Create a cell.
 207
 208        Args:
 209            content: Text, number, or drawable object.
 210
 211        Examples:
 212            >>> Cell(42).content
 213            42
 214        """
 215        object.__setattr__(self, "_layout_revision", 0)
 216        self.content = content
 217        self._format: dict[str, Any] = {}
 218        self._background: dict[str, Any] = {}
 219
 220    def __setattr__(self, name: str, value: Any) -> None:
 221        object.__setattr__(self, name, value)
 222        if name == "content" and "_layout_revision" in vars(self):
 223            object.__setattr__(
 224                self, "_layout_revision", self._layout_revision + 1
 225            )
 226
 227    def set_format(self, **kwargs: Any) -> Self:
 228        """Set cell styling (merged on top of row/column/table).
 229
 230        Content keys go to ``_format``. Background keys (``fill``,
 231        ``fill_color``, ``fill_alpha``, ``stroke``, ``line_color``,
 232        ``line_alpha``, ``line_width``) go to ``_background``, same as
 233        ``cell.fill_color = ...``.
 234
 235        Examples:
 236            >>> cell = Cell("x")
 237            >>> cell.set_format(bold=True) is cell
 238            True
 239            >>> cell._format["bold"]
 240            True
 241            >>> _ = cell.set_format(fill=True, fill_color="gold")
 242            >>> cell._background["fill"]
 243            True
 244        """
 245        format_kwargs, background_kwargs = _split_style_kwargs(kwargs)
 246        self._format.update(format_kwargs)
 247        self._background.update(background_kwargs)
 248        if format_kwargs:
 249            object.__setattr__(
 250                self, "_layout_revision", self._layout_revision + 1
 251            )
 252        return self
 253
 254    def set_background(self, **kwargs: Any) -> Self:
 255        """Set background styling for this cell.
 256
 257        Examples:
 258            >>> cell = Cell("x")
 259            >>> _ = cell.set_background(fill=True)
 260            >>> cell._background["fill"]
 261            True
 262        """
 263        self._background.update(kwargs)
 264        return self

 267class Column:
 268    """Table column: header label and column-wide styling.
 269
 270    Examples:
 271        >>> table = Table(columns=["H"])
 272        >>> table._columns[0].header
 273        'H'
 274    """
 275
 276    def __init__(self, table: Table, index: int, header: str = "") -> None:
 277        self._table = table
 278        self.index = index
 279        self._header = header
 280        self._format: dict[str, Any] = {}
 281        self._background: dict[str, Any] = {}
 282        self._width: float | None = None
 283        self.header_cell = Cell(header)
 284
 285    @property
 286    def header(self) -> str:
 287        """Column header label.
 288
 289        Examples:
 290            >>> table = Table(columns=["Name"])
 291            >>> table.column(0).header
 292            'Name'
 293        """
 294        return self._header
 295
 296    @header.setter
 297    def header(self, value: str) -> None:
 298        """Set the column header text.
 299
 300        Examples:
 301            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 302            >>> table.column(0).header = "B"
 303            >>> table.column(0).header
 304            'B'
 305        """
 306        self._header = value
 307        self.header_cell.content = value
 308
 309    def set_format(self, **kwargs: Any) -> Self:
 310        """Apply format to this column (all body cells and the header cell).
 311
 312        Examples:
 313            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 314            >>> _ = table.add_row("x")
 315            >>> _ = table.column(0).set_format(bold=True)
 316            >>> table.cell(0, 0)._format["bold"]
 317            True
 318        """
 319        self._format.update(kwargs)
 320        self.header_cell.set_format(**kwargs)
 321        for row in self._table._rows:
 322            if self.index < len(row.cells):
 323                row.cells[self.index].set_format(**kwargs)
 324        return self
 325
 326    def set_background(self, **kwargs: Any) -> Self:
 327        """Apply background to this column (all body cells and the header cell).
 328
 329        Examples:
 330            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 331            >>> _ = table.column(0).set_background(fill=True)
 332            >>> table._columns[0]._background["fill"]
 333            True
 334        """
 335        self._background.update(kwargs)
 336        self.header_cell.set_background(**kwargs)
 337        for row in self._table._rows:
 338            if self.index < len(row.cells):
 339                row.cells[self.index].set_background(**kwargs)
 340        return self
 341
 342    @property
 343    def b_box(self) -> BoundingBox:
 344        """Axis-aligned box enclosing this column (header and body cells).
 345
 346        Examples:
 347            >>> table = Table(columns=["A", "B"])
 348            >>> _ = table.add_row(1, 2)
 349            >>> table.column(0).b_box.width > 0
 350            True
 351        """
 352        return self._table._column_bbox(self.index)
 353

 355class Row:
 356    """Table data row: cells and row-wide styling.
 357
 358    Examples:
 359        >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 360        >>> row = table.add_row("v")
 361        >>> row.cells[0].content
 362        'v'
 363    """
 364
 365    def __init__(self, table: Table, index: int, cells: Sequence[Any]) -> None:
 366        self._table = table
 367        self.index = index
 368        self.cells: list[Cell] = [
 369            cell if isinstance(cell, Cell) else Cell(cell) for cell in cells
 370        ]
 371        self._format: dict[str, Any] = {}
 372        self._background: dict[str, Any] = {}
 373        self._height: float | None = None
 374
 375    def set_format(self, **kwargs: Any) -> Self:
 376        """Apply format to every cell in this row.
 377
 378        Examples:
 379            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 380            >>> row = table.add_row("x")
 381            >>> _ = row.set_format(italic=True)
 382            >>> row.cells[0]._format["italic"]
 383            True
 384        """
 385        self._format.update(kwargs)
 386        for cell in self.cells:
 387            cell.set_format(**kwargs)
 388        return self
 389
 390    def set_background(self, **kwargs: Any) -> Self:
 391        """Apply background to every cell in this row.
 392
 393        Examples:
 394            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 395            >>> row = table.add_row("x")
 396            >>> _ = row.set_background(fill=True)
 397            >>> row._background["fill"]
 398            True
 399        """
 400        self._background.update(kwargs)
 401        for cell in self.cells:
 402            cell.set_background(**kwargs)
 403        return self
 404
 405    @property
 406    def b_box(self) -> BoundingBox:
 407        """Axis-aligned box enclosing this data row's cells.
 408
 409        Examples:
 410            >>> table = Table(columns=["A", "B"])
 411            >>> _ = table.add_row(1, 2)
 412            >>> table.row(0).b_box.width > 0
 413            True
 414        """
 415        return self._table._row_bbox(self.index)

 418def _is_contiguous_indices(indices: list[int]) -> bool:
 419    if not indices:
 420        return True
 421    first, last = indices[0], indices[-1]
 422    return indices == list(range(first, last + 1))
 423
 424
 425def _slice_pick_indices(
 426    start: int,
 427    end: int,
 428    key: int | slice,
 429    *,
 430    base: list[int] | None = None,
 431) -> list[int]:
 432    """Map an index or slice onto a list of grid indices (supports step)."""
 433    if base is None:
 434        if start > end:
 435            raise IndexError("range index out of range")
 436        indices = list(range(start, end + 1))
 437    else:
 438        indices = base
 439    picked = indices[key]
 440    if isinstance(picked, int):
 441        return [picked]
 442    return list(picked)
 443
 444
 445def _explicit_indices(picked: list[int]) -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
 446    if not picked or _is_contiguous_indices(picked):
 447        return None
 448    return tuple(picked)

 502def _range_style_target(name: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
 503    """Return ``("format"|"background", storage_name)`` or ``None``."""
 504    if name in _RANGE_STYLE_ALIASES:
 505        return "format", _RANGE_STYLE_ALIASES[name]
 506    if name in _RANGE_FORMAT_KEYS:
 507        return "format", name
 508    if name in _RANGE_BACKGROUND_KEYS:
 509        return "background", name
 510    return None
 511
 512
 513def _split_style_kwargs(kwargs: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
 514    """Split mixed style kwargs into format vs background stores."""
 515    format_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
 516    background_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
 517    for name, value in kwargs.items():
 518        target = _range_style_target(name)
 519        if target is None:
 520            format_kwargs[name] = value
 521            continue
 522        kind, storage_name = target
 523        if storage_name in ("align", "v_align"):
 524            value = _resolve_align(value)
 525        if kind == "background":
 526            background_kwargs[storage_name] = value
 527        else:
 528            format_kwargs[storage_name] = value
 529    return format_kwargs, background_kwargs

 532class Range:
 533    """Rectangular grid region (inclusive bounds, 0-based grid indices).
 534
 535    **Grid coordinates:** ``row`` and ``col`` are integers starting at ``0``.
 536    Column ``0`` is the leftmost column. Row numbering follows the table
 537    origin: top-down by default, bottom-up when ``table.from_bottom_left`` is
 538    True. The header row is included only when explicit headers are shown. This
 539    matches :attr:`Table.cells`, :meth:`Table.range`, and :meth:`Table.cell`.
 540
 541    Single cell: ``table.range(r, c, r, c).cell`` or ``table.cells[r, c]``.
 542
 543    ``table.columns[i]`` / ``table.columns[i:j]`` slice **column indices**
 544    ``0``, ``1``, … ``table.rows[i]`` slices **data rows** only (header
 545    excluded); ``table.rows[0]`` is the first body row.
 546
 547    ``table.cells[row, col]`` is NumPy-style (grid row first). A lone index or
 548    slice on ``table.cells`` selects grid rows and keeps all columns.
 549
 550    Assign format or background attributes on a range to apply them to every
 551    cell in the range (column/row ranges also store the value on the
 552    ``Column`` / ``Row`` so later rows inherit it).
 553
 554    Examples:
 555        >>> table = Table(columns=["A", "B"])
 556        >>> _ = table.add_row(1, 2)
 557        >>> table.cells.font_size = 12
 558        >>> table.cell(1, 0).content
 559        1
 560        >>> table.column(0).header
 561        'A'
 562"""
 563
 564    def __init__(
 565        self,
 566        table: Table,
 567        row_start: int,
 568        col_start: int,
 569        row_end: int,
 570        col_end: int,
 571        *,
 572        size_axis: Literal["columns", "rows"] | None = None,
 573        explicit_grid_rows: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
 574        explicit_grid_cols: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
 575    ) -> None:
 576        if row_start < 0 or row_end < 0 or col_start < 0 or col_end < 0:
 577            object.__setattr__(self, "_table", table)
 578            object.__setattr__(self, "_row_start", row_start)
 579            object.__setattr__(self, "_row_end", row_end)
 580            object.__setattr__(self, "_col_start", col_start)
 581            object.__setattr__(self, "_col_end", col_end)
 582            object.__setattr__(self, "_size_axis", size_axis)
 583            object.__setattr__(self, "_explicit_grid_rows", None)
 584            object.__setattr__(self, "_explicit_grid_cols", None)
 585            return
 586        object.__setattr__(self, "_table", table)
 587        object.__setattr__(self, "_row_start", min(row_start, row_end))
 588        object.__setattr__(self, "_row_end", max(row_start, row_end))
 589        object.__setattr__(self, "_col_start", min(col_start, col_end))
 590        object.__setattr__(self, "_col_end", max(col_start, col_end))
 591        object.__setattr__(self, "_size_axis", size_axis)
 592        object.__setattr__(self, "_explicit_grid_rows", explicit_grid_rows)
 593        object.__setattr__(self, "_explicit_grid_cols", explicit_grid_cols)
 594
 595    def _empty_subrange(self) -> Range:
 596        return Range(
 597            self._table,
 598            0,
 599            0,
 600            -1,
 601            -1,
 602            size_axis=self._size_axis,
 603        )
 604
 605    def __getitem__(
 606        self,
 607        key: int | slice | tuple[int | slice, int | slice],
 608    ) -> Range:
 609        if self._size_axis == "columns":
 610            if not isinstance(key, (int, slice)):
 611                raise TypeError("columns range indices must be an int or slice")
 612            col_base = (
 613                list(self._explicit_grid_cols)
 614                if self._explicit_grid_cols is not None
 615                else None
 616            )
 617            picked_cols = _slice_pick_indices(
 618                self._col_start,
 619                self._col_end,
 620                key,
 621                base=col_base,
 622            )
 623            if not picked_cols:
 624                return self._empty_subrange()
 625            return Range(
 626                self._table,
 627                self._row_start,
 628                picked_cols[0],
 629                self._row_end,
 630                picked_cols[-1],
 631                size_axis="columns",
 632                explicit_grid_rows=self._explicit_grid_rows,
 633                explicit_grid_cols=_explicit_indices(picked_cols),
 634            )
 635        if self._size_axis == "rows":
 636            if not isinstance(key, (int, slice)):
 637                raise TypeError("rows range indices must be an int or slice")
 638            row_base = (
 639                list(self._explicit_grid_rows)
 640                if self._explicit_grid_rows is not None
 641                else None
 642            )
 643            picked_rows = _slice_pick_indices(
 644                self._row_start,
 645                self._row_end,
 646                key,
 647                base=row_base,
 648            )
 649            if not picked_rows:
 650                return self._empty_subrange()
 651            return Range(
 652                self._table,
 653                picked_rows[0],
 654                self._col_start,
 655                picked_rows[-1],
 656                self._col_end,
 657                size_axis="rows",
 658                explicit_grid_rows=_explicit_indices(picked_rows),
 659                explicit_grid_cols=self._explicit_grid_cols,
 660            )
 661        if isinstance(key, (int, slice)):
 662            row_key: int | slice = key
 663            col_key: int | slice = slice(None)
 664        elif isinstance(key, tuple) and len(key) == 2:
 665            row_key, col_key = key
 666        else:
 667            raise TypeError(
 668                "cell range indices must be a row index/slice or a "
 669                "(row, column) pair of ints or slices"
 670            )
 671        if not isinstance(row_key, (int, slice)) or not isinstance(
 672            col_key, (int, slice)
 673        ):
 674            raise TypeError(
 675                "cell range indices must be a row index/slice or a "
 676                "(row, column) pair of ints or slices"
 677            )
 678        row_base = (
 679            list(self._explicit_grid_rows)
 680            if self._explicit_grid_rows is not None
 681            else None
 682        )
 683        col_base = (
 684            list(self._explicit_grid_cols)
 685            if self._explicit_grid_cols is not None
 686            else None
 687        )
 688        picked_rows = _slice_pick_indices(
 689            self._row_start,
 690            self._row_end,
 691            row_key,
 692            base=row_base,
 693        )
 694        picked_cols = _slice_pick_indices(
 695            self._col_start,
 696            self._col_end,
 697            col_key,
 698            base=col_base,
 699        )
 700        if not picked_rows or not picked_cols:
 701            return Range(self._table, 0, 0, -1, -1)
 702        return Range(
 703            self._table,
 704            picked_rows[0],
 705            picked_cols[0],
 706            picked_rows[-1],
 707            picked_cols[-1],
 708            explicit_grid_rows=_explicit_indices(picked_rows),
 709            explicit_grid_cols=_explicit_indices(picked_cols),
 710        )
 711
 712    def _is_empty(self) -> bool:
 713        return (
 714            self._row_end < self._row_start or self._col_end < self._col_start
 715        )
 716
 717    def _grid_row_indices(self) -> list[int]:
 718        if self._is_empty():
 719            return []
 720        if self._explicit_grid_rows is not None:
 721            return list(self._explicit_grid_rows)
 722        return list(range(self._row_start, self._row_end + 1))
 723
 724    def _grid_col_indices(self) -> list[int]:
 725        if self._is_empty():
 726            return []
 727        if self._explicit_grid_cols is not None:
 728            return list(self._explicit_grid_cols)
 729        return list(range(self._col_start, self._col_end + 1))
 730
 731    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
 732        if name == "width":
 733            return self._common_column_width()
 734        if name == "height":
 735            return self._common_row_height()
 736        if name == "size":
 737            return (self.width, self.height)
 738        target = _range_style_target(name)
 739        if target is None:
 740            raise AttributeError(
 741                f"'{type(self).__name__}' object has no attribute '{name}'"
 742            )
 743        _kind, storage_name = target
 744        return self._style_value(storage_name, _kind)
 745
 746    def __setattr__(self, name: str, value: Any) -> None:
 747        if name.startswith("_"):
 748            object.__setattr__(self, name, value)
 749            return
 750        if name == "content":
 751            self.cell.content = value
 752            return
 753        if name == "width":
 754            self._assign_width(value)
 755            return
 756        if name == "height":
 757            self._assign_height(value)
 758            return
 759        if name == "size":
 760            width, height = value[:2]
 761            self._assign_width(width)
 762            self._assign_height(height)
 763            return
 764        target = _range_style_target(name)
 765        if target is None:
 766            raise AttributeError(
 767                f"'{type(self).__name__}' object has no attribute '{name}'"
 768            )
 769        kind, storage_name = target
 770        if storage_name in ("align", "v_align"):
 771            value = _resolve_align(value)
 772        self._apply_style(kind, storage_name, value)
 773
 774    def _style_store(self, cell: Cell, kind: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 775        if kind == "format":
 776            return cell._format
 777        return cell._background
 778
 779    def _style_value(self, storage_name: str, kind: str) -> Any:
 780        first = None
 781        saw_value = False
 782        for cell in self:
 783            store = self._style_store(cell, kind)
 784            if storage_name not in store:
 785                return None
 786            current = store[storage_name]
 787            if not saw_value:
 788                first = current
 789                saw_value = True
 790            elif current != first:
 791                return None
 792        if not saw_value:
 793            return None
 794        return first
 795
 796    def _apply_style(self, kind: str, storage_name: str, value: Any) -> None:
 797        if self._is_empty():
 798            raise ValueError("assignment on an empty range")
 799        kwargs = {storage_name: value}
 800        if self._size_axis == "columns":
 801            for col_index in self._grid_col_indices():
 802                column = self._table._columns[col_index]
 803                if kind == "format":
 804                    column.set_format(**kwargs)
 805                else:
 806                    column.set_background(**kwargs)
 807            return
 808        if self._size_axis == "rows":
 809            header_rows = 1 if _has_header_row(self._table) else 0
 810            for grid_row in self._grid_row_indices():
 811                data_row = grid_row - header_rows
 812                row = self._table._rows[data_row]
 813                if kind == "format":
 814                    row.set_format(**kwargs)
 815                else:
 816                    row.set_background(**kwargs)
 817            return
 818        if kind == "format":
 819            self.set_format(**kwargs)
 820        else:
 821            self.set_background(**kwargs)
 822
 823    @property
 824    def cell(self) -> Cell:
 825        """The sole cell when this range is one grid cell.
 826
 827        Examples:
 828            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 829            >>> _ = table.add_row("v")
 830            >>> table.range(1, 0, 1, 0).cell.content
 831            'v'
 832        """
 833        if self._row_start != self._row_end or self._col_start != self._col_end:
 834            raise ValueError("cell is only defined for a single-cell range")
 835        return self._table._cell_at_grid(self._row_start, self._col_start)
 836
 837    @property
 838    def content(self) -> Any:
 839        """Content of a single-cell range.
 840
 841        Examples:
 842            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 843            >>> _ = table.add_row(7)
 844            >>> table.range(1, 0, 1, 0).content
 845            7
 846        """
 847        return self.cell.content
 848
 849    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[Cell]:
 850        for grid_row in self._grid_row_indices():
 851            for col_index in self._grid_col_indices():
 852                yield self._table._cell_at_grid(grid_row, col_index)
 853
 854    @property
 855    def cells(self) -> list[list[Cell]]:
 856        """Cell matrix for this range (rows, then columns).
 857
 858        Examples:
 859            >>> table = Table(columns=["A", "B"])
 860            >>> _ = table.add_row(1, 2)
 861            >>> len(table.cells.cells)
 862            2
 863        """
 864        matrix: list[list[Cell]] = []
 865        for grid_row in self._grid_row_indices():
 866            row_cells: list[Cell] = []
 867            for col_index in self._grid_col_indices():
 868                row_cells.append(  # noqa: PERF401
 869                    self._table._cell_at_grid(grid_row, col_index)
 870                )
 871            matrix.append(row_cells)
 872        return matrix
 873
 874    def set_format(self, **kwargs: Any) -> Self:
 875        """Apply format to every cell in this range.
 876
 877        Examples:
 878            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 879            >>> _ = table.add_row("x")
 880            >>> _ = table.rows.set_format(bold=True)
 881            >>> table.cell(1, 0)._format["bold"]
 882            True
 883        """
 884        for cell in self:
 885            cell.set_format(**kwargs)
 886        return self
 887
 888    def set_background(self, **kwargs: Any) -> Self:
 889        """Apply background to every cell in this range.
 890
 891        Examples:
 892            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 893            >>> _ = table.add_row("x")
 894            >>> _ = table.rows.set_background(fill=True)
 895            >>> table.cell(1, 0)._background["fill"]
 896            True
 897        """
 898        for cell in self:
 899            cell.set_background(**kwargs)
 900        return self
 901
 902    def _assign_width(self, width: float | Sequence[float]) -> None:
 903        if self._is_empty():
 904            raise ValueError("width assignment on an empty range")
 905        self._table._apply_column_widths(
 906            self._col_start, self._col_end, width
 907        )
 908
 909    def _assign_height(self, height: float | Sequence[float]) -> None:
 910        if self._is_empty():
 911            raise ValueError("height assignment on an empty range")
 912        grid_rows = self._grid_row_indices()
 913        if (
 914            self._explicit_grid_rows is None
 915            and len(grid_rows) == self._row_end - self._row_start + 1
 916        ):
 917            self._table._apply_grid_row_heights(
 918                self._row_start, self._row_end, height
 919            )
 920            return
 921        for grid_row, row_height in zip(
 922            grid_rows,
 923            self._table._sizes_for_span(len(grid_rows), height, kind="row"),
 924            strict=True,
 925        ):
 926            if _has_header_row(self._table) and grid_row == 0:
 927                self._table._header_row_height = row_height
 928            else:
 929                data_row = grid_row - (1 if _has_header_row(self._table) else 0)
 930                self._table._rows[data_row]._height = row_height
 931        self._table._invalidate_layout()
 932
 933    def _common_column_width(self) -> float | None:
 934        first = None
 935        saw_value = False
 936        for col_index in self._grid_col_indices():
 937            current = self._table._columns[col_index]._width
 938            if not saw_value:
 939                first = current
 940                saw_value = True
 941            elif current != first:
 942                return None
 943        if not saw_value:
 944            return None
 945        return first
 946
 947    def _stored_grid_row_height(self, grid_row: int) -> float | None:
 948        table = self._table
 949        if _has_header_row(table) and grid_row == 0:
 950            return table._header_row_height
 951        data_row = grid_row - (1 if _has_header_row(table) else 0)
 952        return table._rows[data_row]._height
 953
 954    def _common_row_height(self) -> float | None:
 955        first = None
 956        saw_value = False
 957        for grid_row in self._grid_row_indices():
 958            current = self._stored_grid_row_height(grid_row)
 959            if not saw_value:
 960                first = current
 961                saw_value = True
 962            elif current != first:
 963                return None
 964        if not saw_value:
 965            return None
 966        return first
 967
 968    @property
 969    def b_box(self) -> BoundingBox:
 970        """Axis-aligned box enclosing this range.
 971
 972        Examples:
 973            >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
 974            >>> _ = table.add_row("x")
 975            >>> table.cells.b_box.width > 0
 976            True
 977        """
 978        boxes = [
 979            table_cell_bbox(self._table, grid_row, col_index)
 980            for grid_row in self._grid_row_indices()
 981            for col_index in self._grid_col_indices()
 982        ]
 983        return _union_bounding_boxes(boxes)
 984
 985
 986def _rich_color(color: Color | str) -> str:
 987    """Return a color string Rich can parse.
 988
 989    Examples:
 990        >>> _rich_color(white)
 991        'rgb(255, 255, 255)'
 992        >>> _rich_color("blue")
 993        'blue'
 994    """
 995    if isinstance(color, str):
 996        return color
 997    red = int(round(color.red * 255))
 998    green = int(round(color.green * 255))
 999    blue = int(round(color.blue * 255))
1000    return f"rgb({red}, {green}, {blue})"
1001
1002
1003def _resolve_cell_format(
1004    table: Table,
1005    grid_row: int,
1006    col_index: int,
1007) -> dict[str, Any]:
1008    has_header = _has_header_row(table)
1009    is_header = has_header and grid_row == 0
1010    data_row_index = grid_row - (1 if has_header else 0)
1011    layers = [
1012        _TABLE_DEFAULT_FORMAT,
1013        table._format,
1014    ]
1015    if col_index < len(table._columns):
1016        column = table._columns[col_index]
1017        layers.append(column._format)
1018    if is_header:
1019        if col_index < len(table._columns):
1020            layers.append(table._columns[col_index].header_cell._format)
1021    else:
1022        row = table._rows[data_row_index]
1023        layers.append(row._format)
1024        if col_index < len(row.cells):
1025            layers.append(row.cells[col_index]._format)
1026    fmt = _merge_style(*layers)
1027    if is_header and _TABLE_DEFAULT_HEADER_BOLD and "bold" not in fmt:
1028        fmt = dict(fmt)
1029        fmt["bold"] = True
1030    if is_header and "font_color" not in fmt:
1031        background = _resolve_cell_background(table, grid_row, col_index)
1032        if background["fill"]:
1033            fmt = dict(fmt)
1034            fmt["font_color"] = white
1035    return fmt
1036
1037
1038def _default_cell_background(table: Table, *, is_header: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
1039    from ..config.settings import runtime_defaults
1040
1041    fill = runtime_defaults["table_fill"]
1042    if is_header:
1043        fill = runtime_defaults["header_row_fill"]
1044    return {"fill": fill, "stroke": _TABLE_DEFAULT_STROKE}
1045
1046
1047def _resolve_cell_background(
1048    table: Table,
1049    grid_row: int,
1050    col_index: int,
1051) -> dict[str, Any]:
1052    has_header = _has_header_row(table)
1053    is_header = has_header and grid_row == 0
1054    data_row_index = grid_row - (1 if has_header else 0)
1055    layers = [
1056        _default_cell_background(table, is_header=is_header),
1057        table._background,
1058    ]
1059    if col_index < len(table._columns):
1060        column = table._columns[col_index]
1061        layers.append(column._background)
1062    if is_header:
1063        if col_index < len(table._columns):
1064            layers.append(table._columns[col_index].header_cell._background)
1065    else:
1066        row = table._rows[data_row_index]
1067        layers.append(row._background)
1068        if col_index < len(row.cells):
1069            layers.append(row.cells[col_index]._background)
1070    return _merge_style(*layers)
1071
1072
1073def _grid_dimensions(table: Table) -> tuple[int, int]:
1074    column_count = len(table._columns)
1075    row_count = len(table._rows) + (1 if _has_header_row(table) else 0)
1076    return column_count, row_count
1077
1078
1079def _layout_content_cache_key(content: Any) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
1080    if isinstance(content, Cell):
1081        return (
1082            Cell,
1083            content._layout_revision,
1084            _layout_content_cache_key(content.content),
1085        )
1086    if isinstance(content, SplitCell):
1087        return (
1088            SplitCell,
1089            content.kind,
1090            content.first,
1091            content.second,
1092            tuple(content.offset1),
1093            tuple(content.offset2),
1094        )
1095    if _is_drawable_content(content):
1096        box = content.b_box
1097        return type(content), id(content), box.width, box.height
1098    if content is None or isinstance(content, (str, int, float, bool)):
1099        return type(content), content
1100    return type(content), str(content)
1101
1102
1103def _table_layout_cache_key(table: Table) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
1104    cell_keys: list[tuple[Any, ...]] = []
1105    for column in table._columns:
1106        header_cell = column.header_cell
1107        cell_keys.append(
1108            (
1109                header_cell._layout_revision,
1110                _layout_content_cache_key(header_cell.content),
1111            )
1112        )
1113    for row in table._rows:
1114        cell_keys.extend(
1115            (
1116                cell._layout_revision,
1117                _layout_content_cache_key(cell.content),
1118            )
1119            for cell in row.cells
1120        )
1121    return table._layout_revision, tuple(cell_keys)
1122
1123
1124def _has_header_row(table: Table) -> bool:
1125    return table.show_header and table._explicit_headers and bool(table._columns)
1126
1127
1128def _public_body_grid_rows(table: Table) -> list[int]:
1129    header_offset = 1 if _has_header_row(table) else 0
1130    rows = list(range(header_offset, header_offset + len(table._rows)))
1131    if table.from_bottom_left:
1132        rows.reverse()
1133    return rows
1134
1135
1136def _public_full_grid_rows(table: Table) -> list[int]:
1137    body_rows = _public_body_grid_rows(table)
1138    if not _has_header_row(table):
1139        return body_rows
1140    if table.from_bottom_left:
1141        return body_rows + [0]
1142    return [0] + body_rows
1143
1144
1145def _storage_row_index(table: Table, row_index: int) -> int:
1146    if row_index < 0 or row_index >= len(table._rows):
1147        raise IndexError(f"row index {row_index} out of range")
1148    if table.from_bottom_left:
1149        return len(table._rows) - 1 - row_index
1150    return row_index
1151
1152
1153def _grid_row_from_data_row(table: Table, row_index: int) -> int:
1154    header_offset = 1 if _has_header_row(table) else 0
1155    return header_offset + _storage_row_index(table, row_index)
1156
1157
1158def _empty_grid_range(table: Table) -> Range:
1159    """Range that contains no cells (empty table or zero columns)."""
1160    return Range(table, 0, 0, -1, -1)
1161
1162
1163def _cell_content_size(
1164    content: Any, fmt: dict[str, Any]
1165) -> tuple[float, float]:
1166    if isinstance(content, Cell):
1167        content = content.content
1168    if isinstance(content, SplitCell):
1169        first_w, first_h = _cell_content_size(content.first, fmt)
1170        second_w, second_h = _cell_content_size(content.second, fmt)
1171        if content.kind == SplitCell.VERTICAL:
1172            return first_w + second_w, max(first_h, second_h)
1173        if content.kind == SplitCell.HORIZONTAL:
1174            return max(first_w, second_w), first_h + second_h
1175        return first_w + second_w, first_h + second_h
1176    if isinstance(content, (str, int, float, bool)):
1177        text = str(content)
1178        formula = _tag_latex_formula(text)
1179        if formula is not None:
1180            font_family = (
1181                fmt["font_family"] if "font_family" in fmt else None
1182            )
1183            bold = fmt["bold"] if "bold" in fmt else False
1184            return _measure_latex_formula(
1185                formula, fmt["font_size"], font_family, bold
1186            )
1187        tag = Tag(text, (0.0, 0.0), font_size=fmt["font_size"])
1188        box = tag.b_box
1189        return box.width, box.height
1190    if _is_drawable_content(content):
1191        box = content.b_box
1192        return box.width, box.height
1193    text = str(content)
1194    tag = Tag(text, (0.0, 0.0), font_size=fmt["font_size"])
1195    box = tag.b_box
1196    return box.width, box.height
1197
1198
1199def _table_padding_xy(table: Table) -> tuple[float, float]:
1200    padding = table.padding
1201    if type(padding) in (int, float):
1202        if padding < 0:
1203            raise ValueError("padding must be non-negative")
1204        value = float(padding)
1205        return value, value
1206    if not isinstance(padding, Sequence) or isinstance(padding, (str, bytes)):
1207        raise ValueError(
1208            "padding must be a non-negative number or a (horizontal, vertical) pair"
1209        )
1210    values = list(padding)
1211    if len(values) != 2:
1212        raise ValueError(
1213            "padding must be a non-negative number or a (horizontal, vertical) pair"
1214        )
1215    horizontal, vertical = values
1216    if (
1217        type(horizontal) not in (int, float)
1218        or type(vertical) not in (int, float)
1219        or horizontal < 0
1220        or vertical < 0
1221    ):
1222        raise ValueError(
1223            "padding must be a non-negative number or a (horizontal, vertical) pair"
1224        )
1225    return float(horizontal), float(vertical)
1226
1227
1228def compute_table_layout(
1229    table: Table,
1230) -> tuple[list[float], list[float], int]:
1231    """Return column widths, row heights, and column count for ``table``.
1232
1233    Examples:
1234        >>> table = Table(columns=["A", "B"])
1235        >>> _ = table.add_row(1, 22)
1236        >>> widths, heights, n_cols = compute_table_layout(table)
1237        >>> n_cols
1238        2
1239        >>> len(widths)
1240        2
1241        >>> len(heights)
1242        2
1243        >>> square = Table(size=(2, 2), column_width=30, row_height=30, padding=0)
1244        >>> compute_table_layout(square)
1245        ([30, 30], [30, 30], 2)
1246    """
1247    cache_key = _table_layout_cache_key(table)
1248    if (
1249        table._layout_cache_key == cache_key
1250        and table._layout_cache is not None
1251    ):
1252        cached_widths, cached_heights, cached_column_count = (
1253            table._layout_cache
1254        )
1255        return (
1256            list(cached_widths),
1257            list(cached_heights),
1258            cached_column_count,
1259        )
1260
1261    column_count, grid_row_count = _grid_dimensions(table)
1262    if column_count == 0:
1263        return [], [], 0
1264
1265    col_widths = [0.0] * column_count
1266    row_heights = [0.0] * grid_row_count
1267
1268    padding_x, padding_y = _table_padding_xy(table)
1269    pad_x = 2 * padding_x
1270    pad_y = 2 * padding_y
1271    has_header = _has_header_row(table)
1272
1273    for grid_row in range(grid_row_count):
1274        for col_index in range(column_count):
1275            fmt = _resolve_cell_format(table, grid_row, col_index)
1276            if has_header and grid_row == 0:
1277                content = table._columns[col_index].header_cell.content
1278            else:
1279                data_row = grid_row - (1 if has_header else 0)
1280                content = table._rows[data_row].cells[col_index].content
1281            content_w, content_h = _cell_content_size(content, fmt)
1282            col_widths[col_index] = max(
1283                col_widths[col_index], content_w + pad_x
1284            )
1285            row_heights[grid_row] = max(
1286                row_heights[grid_row], content_h + pad_y
1287            )
1288
1289    for col_index in range(column_count):
1290        width = table._columns[col_index]._width
1291        if width is not None:
1292            col_widths[col_index] = max(col_widths[col_index], width)
1293
1294    for grid_row in range(grid_row_count):
1295        if has_header and grid_row == 0:
1296            header_height = table._header_row_height
1297            if header_height is not None:
1298                row_heights[grid_row] = max(
1299                    row_heights[grid_row], header_height
1300                )
1301        else:
1302            data_row = grid_row - (1 if has_header else 0)
1303            height = table._rows[data_row]._height
1304            if height is not None:
1305                row_heights[grid_row] = max(row_heights[grid_row], height)
1306
1307    if table.min_width is not None:
1308        total = sum(col_widths)
1309        if total < table.min_width and column_count:
1310            extra = (table.min_width - total) / column_count
1311            col_widths = [width + extra for width in col_widths]
1312
1313    table._layout_cache_key = cache_key
1314    table._layout_cache = (
1315        tuple(col_widths),
1316        tuple(row_heights),
1317        column_count,
1318    )
1319
1320    return col_widths, row_heights, column_count
1321
1322
1323def _bbox_from_cell_bounds(
1324    x_left: float,
1325    y_top: float,
1326    x_right: float,
1327    y_bottom: float,
1328) -> BoundingBox:
1329    southwest = (x_left, y_bottom)
1330    northeast = (x_right, y_top)
1331    return BoundingBox(southwest, northeast)
1332
1333
1334def _union_bounding_boxes(boxes: Sequence[BoundingBox]) -> BoundingBox:
1335    points: list[PointType] = []
1336    for box in boxes:
1337        if box.southwest is None:
1338            continue
1339        points.extend(box.corners)
1340    if not points:
1341        return BoundingBox()
1342    return bounding_box(points)
1343
1344
1345def table_cell_bbox(
1346    table: Table,
1347    grid_row: int,
1348    col_index: int,
1349) -> BoundingBox:
1350    """Bounding box of one grid cell.
1351
1352    Examples:
1353        >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
1354        >>> _ = table.add_row("x")
1355        >>> box = table_cell_bbox(table, 1, 0)
1356        >>> box.width > 0
1357        True
1358    """
1359    col_widths, row_heights, column_count = compute_table_layout(table)
1360    if col_index >= column_count or grid_row >= len(row_heights):
1361        return BoundingBox()
1362    pos = table.pos[:2]
1363    x_left, y_top, x_right, y_bottom = _cell_box(
1364        pos,
1365        col_widths,
1366        row_heights,
1367        grid_row,
1368        col_index,
1369    )
1370    return _bbox_from_cell_bounds(x_left, y_top, x_right, y_bottom)
1371
1372
1373def table_grid_bbox(table: Table) -> BoundingBox:
1374    """Bounding box of the full cell grid.
1375
1376    Examples:
1377        >>> table = Table(columns=["A", "B"])
1378        >>> _ = table.add_row(1, 2)
1379        >>> table_grid_bbox(table).width > 0
1380        True
1381    """
1382    col_widths, row_heights, _ = compute_table_layout(table)
1383    if not col_widths or not row_heights:
1384        return BoundingBox()
1385    pos = table.pos[:2]
1386    x0, y0 = pos
1387    return _bbox_from_cell_bounds(
1388        x0,
1389        y0,
1390        x0 + sum(col_widths),
1391        y0 - sum(row_heights),
1392    )
1393
1394
1395def table_title_bbox(table: Table) -> BoundingBox | None:
1396    """Bounding box of the title tag, or ``None`` when ``title`` is empty.
1397
1398    Examples:
1399        >>> table = Table(title="", columns=["A"])
1400        >>> table_title_bbox(table) is None
1401        True
1402        >>> table.title = "Summary"
1403        >>> table_title_bbox(table).width > 0
1404        True
1405    """
1406    if not table.title:
1407        return None
1408    pos = table.pos[:2]
1409    title_y = pos[1] + _TABLE_DEFAULT_TITLE_PAD
1410    title_tag = Tag(
1411        table.title,
1412        (pos[0], title_y),
1413        font_size=table.font_size + 2,
1414        bold=True,
1415        anchor=Anchor.WEST,
1416        align=Align.LEFT,
1417    )
1418    return title_tag.b_box
1419
1420
1421def _cell_box(
1422    pos: PointType,
1423    col_widths: list[float],
1424    row_heights: list[float],
1425    row_index: int,
1426    col_index: int,
1427) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
1428    x0, y0 = pos[:2]
1429    x_left = x0 + sum(col_widths[:col_index])
1430    x_right = x_left + col_widths[col_index]
1431    y_top = y0 - sum(row_heights[:row_index])
1432    y_bottom = y_top - row_heights[row_index]
1433    return x_left, y_top, x_right, y_bottom
1434
1435
1436def _cell_anchor_pos(
1437    x_left: float,
1438    y_top: float,
1439    x_right: float,
1440    y_bottom: float,
1441    h_align: Align,
1442    v_align: Align,
1443    padding_x: float,
1444    padding_y: float,
1445) -> PointType:
1446    if h_align in (Align.LEFT, Align.FLUSH_LEFT):
1447        x = x_left + padding_x
1448    elif h_align in (Align.RIGHT, Align.FLUSH_RIGHT):
1449        x = x_right - padding_x
1450    else:
1451        x = (x_left + x_right) / 2
1452    if v_align in (Align.TOP,):
1453        y = y_top - padding_y
1454    elif v_align in (Align.BOTTOM,):
1455        y = y_bottom + padding_y
1456    else:
1457        y = (y_top + y_bottom) / 2
1458    return (x, y)
1459
1460
1461def _background_rect_sketch(
1462    canvas: Any,
1463    x_left: float,
1464    y_top: float,
1465    x_right: float,
1466    y_bottom: float,
1467    background: dict[str, Any],
1468) -> list:
1469    fill = background["fill"]
1470    if not fill:
1471        return []
1472    rect = Shape(
1473        [
1474            (x_left, y_top),
1475            (x_right, y_top),
1476            (x_right, y_bottom),
1477            (x_left, y_bottom),
1478        ],
1479        closed=True,
1480    )
1481    sketch_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
1482        "fill": fill,
1483        "stroke": background["stroke"],
1484    }
1485    if "fill_color" in background:
1486        sketch_kwargs["fill_color"] = background["fill_color"]
1487    if "fill_alpha" in background:
1488        sketch_kwargs["fill_alpha"] = background["fill_alpha"]
1489    if "line_color" in background:
1490        sketch_kwargs["line_color"] = background["line_color"]
1491    if "line_alpha" in background:
1492        sketch_kwargs["line_alpha"] = background["line_alpha"]
1493    if "line_width" in background:
1494        sketch_kwargs["line_width"] = background["line_width"]
1495    return get_sketches(rect, canvas, **sketch_kwargs)
1496
1497
1498def _apply_tag_text_format(tag: Tag, fmt: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1499    """Copy cell text-format keys onto ``tag``."""
1500    for name in _TAG_FORMAT_ATTRS:
1501        if name in fmt:
1502            setattr(tag, name, fmt[name])
1503
1504
1505def _tag_for_split_label(
1506    text: str,
1507    pos: PointType,
1508    fmt: dict[str, Any],
1509    align: Align,
1510    anchor: Anchor,
1511) -> Tag:
1512    tag = Tag(
1513        text,
1514        pos,
1515        font_size=fmt["font_size"],
1516        align=align,
1517    )
1518    _apply_tag_text_format(tag, fmt)
1519    tag.anchor = anchor
1520    return tag
1521
1522
1523def _split_cell_sketches(
1524    content: SplitCell,
1525    canvas: Any,
1526    x_left: float,
1527    y_top: float,
1528    x_right: float,
1529    y_bottom: float,
1530    fmt: dict[str, Any],
1531    padding_x: float,
1532    padding_y: float,
1533    **kwargs: Any,
1534) -> list:
1535    x_mid = (x_left + x_right) / 2
1536    y_mid = (y_top + y_bottom) / 2
1537    if content.kind == SplitCell.VERTICAL:
1538        divider = Shape([(x_mid, y_top), (x_mid, y_bottom)])
1539        first_pos = (x_left + padding_x, y_mid)
1540        second_pos = (x_right - padding_x, y_mid)
1541        first_align = Align.LEFT
1542        first_anchor = Anchor.WEST
1543        second_align = Align.RIGHT
1544        second_anchor = Anchor.EAST
1545    elif content.kind == SplitCell.HORIZONTAL:
1546        divider = Shape([(x_left, y_mid), (x_right, y_mid)])
1547        first_pos = (x_mid, y_top - padding_y)
1548        second_pos = (x_mid, y_bottom + padding_y)
1549        first_align = Align.CENTER
1550        first_anchor = Anchor.NORTH
1551        second_align = Align.CENTER
1552        second_anchor = Anchor.SOUTH
1553    elif content.kind == SplitCell.DIAGONAL_DOWN:
1554        divider = Shape([(x_left, y_top), (x_right, y_bottom)])
1555        first_pos = (x_left + padding_x, y_bottom + padding_y)
1556        second_pos = (x_right - padding_x, y_top - padding_y)
1557        first_align = Align.LEFT
1558        first_anchor = Anchor.SOUTHWEST
1559        second_align = Align.RIGHT
1560        second_anchor = Anchor.NORTHEAST
1561    else:
1562        divider = Shape([(x_left, y_bottom), (x_right, y_top)])
1563        first_pos = (x_left + padding_x, y_top - padding_y)
1564        second_pos = (x_right - padding_x, y_bottom + padding_y)
1565        first_align = Align.LEFT
1566        first_anchor = Anchor.NORTHWEST
1567        second_align = Align.RIGHT
1568        second_anchor = Anchor.SOUTHEAST
1569    first_dx, first_dy = content.offset1[:2]
1570    second_dx, second_dy = content.offset2[:2]
1571    first_pos = (first_pos[0] + first_dx, first_pos[1] + first_dy)
1572    second_pos = (second_pos[0] + second_dx, second_pos[1] + second_dy)
1573    first_tag = _tag_for_split_label(
1574        content.first, first_pos, fmt, first_align, first_anchor
1575    )
1576    second_tag = _tag_for_split_label(
1577        content.second, second_pos, fmt, second_align, second_anchor
1578    )
1579    sketches = get_sketches(
1580        divider,
1581        canvas,
1582        stroke=True,
1583        fill=False,
1584        line_width=_TABLE_DEFAULT_GRID_LINE_WIDTH,
1585        line_color=gray,
1586    )
1587    sketches.extend(get_sketches(first_tag, canvas, **kwargs))
1588    sketches.extend(get_sketches(second_tag, canvas, **kwargs))
1589    return sketches
1590
1591
1592def _tag_for_content(
1593    content: Any,
1594    pos: PointType,
1595    fmt: dict[str, Any],
1596) -> Tag:
1597    h_align = _resolve_align(fmt["align"])
1598    tag = Tag(
1599        _cell_display_text(content),
1600        pos,
1601        font_size=fmt["font_size"],
1602        align=h_align,
1603    )
1604    _apply_tag_text_format(tag, fmt)
1605    if h_align in (Align.LEFT, Align.FLUSH_LEFT):
1606        tag.anchor = Anchor.WEST
1607    elif h_align in (Align.RIGHT, Align.FLUSH_RIGHT):
1608        tag.anchor = Anchor.EAST
1609    else:
1610        tag.anchor = Anchor.CENTER
1611    return tag
1612
1613
1614def _grid_line_sketches(
1615    table: Table,
1616    canvas: Any,
1617    pos: PointType,
1618    col_widths: list[float],
1619    row_heights: list[float],
1620) -> list:
1621    sketches: list = []
1622    x0, y0 = pos[:2]
1623    total_w = sum(col_widths)
1624    y = y0
1625    for row_index in range(len(row_heights) + 1):
1626        segment = Shape([(x0, y), (x0 + total_w, y)])
1627        sketches.extend(
1628            get_sketches(
1629                segment,
1630                canvas,
1631                stroke=True,
1632                fill=False,
1633                line_width=_TABLE_DEFAULT_GRID_LINE_WIDTH,
1634                line_color=gray,
1635            )
1636        )
1637        if row_index < len(row_heights):
1638            y -= row_heights[row_index]
1639    x = x0
1640    y_bottom = y0 - sum(row_heights)
1641    for col_index in range(len(col_widths) + 1):
1642        segment = Shape([(x, y0), (x, y_bottom)])
1643        sketches.extend(
1644            get_sketches(
1645                segment,
1646                canvas,
1647                stroke=True,
1648                fill=False,
1649                line_width=_TABLE_DEFAULT_GRID_LINE_WIDTH,
1650                line_color=gray,
1651            )
1652        )
1653        if col_index < len(col_widths):
1654            x += col_widths[col_index]
1655    return sketches
1656
1657
1658def _flatten_sketches(items: Sequence) -> list:
1659    """Flatten nested lists from ``get_sketches`` of groups."""
1660    flattened: list = []
1661    for item in items:
1662        if isinstance(item, list):
1663            flattened.extend(_flatten_sketches(item))
1664        else:
1665            flattened.append(item)
1666    return flattened
1667
1668
1669def build_table_sketch(table: Table, canvas: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> TableSketch:
1670    """Lay out ``table`` and return a ``TableSketch`` for SVG/PDF export.
1671
1672    Examples:
1673        >>> table = Table(columns=["A"])
1674        >>> _ = table.add_row("x")
1675        >>> build_table_sketch.__name__
1676        'build_table_sketch'
1677    """
1678    col_widths, row_heights, column_count = compute_table_layout(table)
1679    pos = table.pos[:2]
1680    sketches: list = []
1681    grid_row_count = len(row_heights)
1682    padding_x, padding_y = _table_padding_xy(table)
1683
1684    if table.title:
1685        title_y = pos[1] + _TABLE_DEFAULT_TITLE_PAD
1686        title_tag = Tag(
1687            table.title,
1688            (pos[0], title_y),
1689            font_size=table.font_size + 2,
1690            bold=True,
1691            anchor=Anchor.WEST,
1692            align=Align.LEFT,
1693        )
1694        sketches.extend(get_sketches(title_tag, canvas, **kwargs))
1695        pos = (pos[0], pos[1] - _TABLE_DEFAULT_TITLE_PAD - table.font_size)
1696
1697    for grid_row in range(grid_row_count):
1698        for col_index in range(column_count):
1699            background = _resolve_cell_background(table, grid_row, col_index)
1700            x_left, y_top, x_right, y_bottom = _cell_box(
1701                pos, col_widths, row_heights, grid_row, col_index
1702            )
1703            sketches.extend(
1704                _background_rect_sketch(
1705                    canvas, x_left, y_top, x_right, y_bottom, background
1706                )
1707            )
1708
1709    if table.show_lines and column_count and row_heights:
1710        sketches.extend(
1711            _grid_line_sketches(table, canvas, pos, col_widths, row_heights)
1712        )
1713
1714    has_header = _has_header_row(table)
1715    for grid_row in range(grid_row_count):
1716        for col_index in range(column_count):
1717            fmt = _resolve_cell_format(table, grid_row, col_index)
1718            h_align = _resolve_align(fmt["align"])
1719            v_align = _resolve_align(
1720                fmt.get("v_align", _TABLE_DEFAULT_ROW_ALIGN)
1721            )
1722            x_left, y_top, x_right, y_bottom = _cell_box(
1723                pos, col_widths, row_heights, grid_row, col_index
1724            )
1725            cell_pos = _cell_anchor_pos(
1726                x_left,
1727                y_top,
1728                x_right,
1729                y_bottom,
1730                h_align,
1731                v_align,
1732                padding_x,
1733                padding_y,
1734            )
1735            if has_header and grid_row == 0:
1736                content = table._columns[col_index].header_cell.content
1737            else:
1738                data_row = grid_row - (1 if has_header else 0)
1739                content = table._rows[data_row].cells[col_index].content
1740            if isinstance(content, Cell):
1741                content = content.content
1742            if isinstance(content, SplitCell):
1743                sketches.extend(
1744                    _split_cell_sketches(
1745                        content,
1746                        canvas,
1747                        x_left,
1748                        y_top,
1749                        x_right,
1750                        y_bottom,
1751                        fmt,
1752                        padding_x,
1753                        padding_y,
1754                        **kwargs,
1755                    )
1756                )
1757            elif _is_drawable_content(content):
1758                midpoint_x, midpoint_y = content.midpoint[:2]
1759                dest_x, dest_y = cell_pos[:2]
1760                shift_x = dest_x - midpoint_x
1761                shift_y = dest_y - midpoint_y
1762                base_sketch_xform = canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
1763                canvas._sketch_xform_matrix = (
1764                    translation_matrix(shift_x, shift_y) @ base_sketch_xform
1765                )
1766                try:
1767                    cell_sketches = get_sketches(content, canvas, **kwargs)
1768                finally:
1769                    canvas._sketch_xform_matrix = base_sketch_xform
1770
1771                sketches.extend(_flatten_sketches(cell_sketches))
1772            else:
1773                tag = _tag_for_content(content, cell_pos, fmt)
1774                sketches.extend(get_sketches(tag, canvas, **kwargs))
1775
1776    return TableSketch(
1777        pos=pos,
1778        column_widths=col_widths,
1779        row_heights=row_heights,
1780        sketches=sketches,
1781        show_lines=table.show_lines,
1782        xform_matrix=canvas._sketch_xform_matrix,
1783    )
1784
1785
1786class Table:
1787    """Documentation table with Rich notebook and vector export.
1788
1789    **Cell indexing:** 0-based column indices ``0``, ``1``, … everywhere.
1790    Use **grid rows** for :attr:`cells`, :meth:`range`, and :meth:`cell`
1791    (row ``0`` is the header when a header is shown; the next row is ``1``).
1792    Use **data rows** for :meth:`row` and :meth:`populate` (row ``0`` is the
1793    first body row). See the module docstring for the full convention.
1794    Header strings in ``columns=["A", "B"]`` are display labels only — not
1795    column coordinates.
1796
1797    Examples:
1798        >>> table = Table(
1799        ...     title="Parameters",
1800        ...     columns=["Name", "Value"],
1801        ...     size=(2, 2),
1802        ...     column_align=[Align.LEFT, Align.RIGHT],
1803        ... )
1804        >>> table.cell(1, 0).content = "n_sides"
1805        >>> table.cell(1, 1).content = 7
1806        >>> table.cell(2, 0).content = "skip"
1807        >>> table.cell(2, 1).content = 3
1808        >>> table.build_rich_table()  # doctest: +ELLIPSIS
1809        <rich.table.Table object at ...>
1810"""
1811
1812    def __init__(
1813        self,
1814        title: str = _TABLE_DEFAULT_TITLE,
1815        columns: Sequence[str] | None = None,
1816        *,
1817        size: tuple[int, int] | None = None,
1818        from_bottom_left: bool = False,
1819        pos: PointType = _TABLE_DEFAULT_POS,
1820        show_header: bool = _TABLE_DEFAULT_SHOW_HEADER,
1821        show_lines: bool = _TABLE_DEFAULT_SHOW_LINES,
1822        column_align: Sequence[Align | str] | None = None,
1823        column_width: float | None = None,
1824        min_width: int | None = _TABLE_DEFAULT_MIN_WIDTH,
1825        padding: tuple[int, int] = _TABLE_DEFAULT_PADDING,
1826        font_size: float = _TABLE_DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE,
1827        row_height: float | None = None,
1828    ) -> None:
1829        """Create an empty table with optional column headers and size.
1830
1831        Args:
1832            title: Table title for notebook and vector output.
1833            columns: Optional column header labels.
1834            size: Optional ``(rows, columns)`` body size to pre-create.
1835            from_bottom_left: Whether row indexing starts at the bottom.
1836            pos: Northwest table position.
1837            show_header: Whether to show the header row.
1838            show_lines: Whether to stroke grid lines.
1839            column_align: Optional per-column alignment list.
1840            column_width: Default width applied to created columns.
1841            min_width: Minimum total table width after layout.
1842            padding: Cell padding for vector layout and Rich preview.
1843            font_size: Base font size.
1844            row_height: Default height applied to created rows.
1845
1846        Raises:
1847            ValueError: If ``size`` is not two non-negative integers, or if
1848                ``columns`` has more labels than ``size[1]``.
1849
1850        Examples:
1851            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1852            >>> table = sg.Table(size=(2, 3))
1853            >>> len(table._rows), len(table._columns)
1854            (2, 3)
1855            >>> bottom = sg.Table(size=(2, 1), from_bottom_left=True)
1856            >>> bottom.cell(0, 0).content = "south"
1857            >>> bottom.cell(1, 0).content = "north"
1858            >>> bottom.row(0).cells[0].content
1859            'south'
1860            >>> no_headers = sg.Table(size=(1, 1))
1861            >>> len(no_headers.cells.cells)
1862            1
1863            >>> sized = sg.Table(columns=["A", "B"], size=(1, 3))
1864            >>> sized.column_headers
1865            ['A', 'B', '']
1866        """
1867        self._layout_cache: (
1868            tuple[tuple[float, ...], tuple[float, ...], int] | None
1869        ) = None
1870        self._layout_cache_key: tuple[Any, ...] | None = None
1871        self._layout_revision = 0
1872        self.title = title
1873        self.pos = pos
1874        self.type = Types.TABLE
1875        self.subtype = Types.TABLE
1876        self.visible = True
1877        self.from_bottom_left = from_bottom_left
1878        self.show_header = show_header
1879        self.show_lines = show_lines
1880        self._explicit_headers = False
1881        self.min_width = min_width
1882        self.padding = padding
1883        self.font_size = font_size
1884        self._format: dict[str, Any] = {"font_size": font_size}
1885        self._background: dict[str, Any] = {}
1886        self._columns: list[Column] = []
1887        self._rows: list[Row] = []
1888        self._default_column_width = column_width
1889        self._default_row_height = row_height
1890        self._header_row_height: float | None = row_height
1891
1892        row_count = 0
1893        target_column_count = 0
1894        if size is not None:
1895            if len(size) != 2:
1896                raise ValueError("size must be a (rows, columns) tuple")
1897            row_count, target_column_count = size
1898            if (
1899                type(row_count) is not int
1900                or type(target_column_count) is not int
1901                or row_count < 0
1902                or target_column_count < 0
1903            ):
1904                raise ValueError(
1905                    "size must contain two non-negative integers"
1906                )
1907
1908        if (
1909            size is not None
1910            and columns is not None
1911            and len(columns) > target_column_count
1912        ):
1913            raise ValueError(
1914                "columns has more labels than the requested size columns"
1915            )
1916
1917        explicit_headers = list(columns) if columns is not None else []
1918        headers = list(explicit_headers)
1919        if target_column_count > len(headers):
1920            headers.extend([""] * (target_column_count - len(headers)))
1921
1922        if explicit_headers:
1923            self._explicit_headers = True
1924        if headers:
1925            aligns = (
1926                list(column_align)
1927                if column_align is not None
1928                else [_TABLE_DEFAULT_COLUMN_ALIGN] * len(headers)
1929            )
1930            for index, header in enumerate(headers):
1931                align = (
1932                    aligns[index]
1933                    if index < len(aligns)
1934                    else _TABLE_DEFAULT_COLUMN_ALIGN
1935                )
1936                column = self._append_column(header)
1937                column.set_format(align=align)
1938
1939        for _ in range(row_count):
1940            self.add_row(*([""] * len(self._columns)))
1941
1942    def __repr__(self) -> str:
1943        """Return a Table string from this table's title.
1944
1945        Examples:
1946            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1947            >>> repr(sg.Table(title="Parameters"))
1948            "Table(title='Parameters')"
1949        """
1950        return f"Table(title={self.title!r})"

1952    @property
1953    def columns(self) -> Range:
1954        """``Range`` over the grid; ``width`` sets column widths.
1955
1956        Examples:
1957            >>> table = Table(columns=["A", "B"])
1958            >>> table.columns._size_axis
1959            'columns'
1960        """
1961        column_count, grid_row_count = _grid_dimensions(self)
1962        if column_count == 0 or grid_row_count == 0:
1963            return Range(self, 0, 0, -1, -1, size_axis="columns")
1964        public_rows = tuple(_public_full_grid_rows(self))
1965        return Range(
1966            self,
1967            0,
1968            0,
1969            grid_row_count - 1,
1970            column_count - 1,
1971            size_axis="columns",
1972            explicit_grid_rows=public_rows,
1973        )

1975    @property
1976    def column_headers(self) -> list[str]:
1977        """Column header labels.
1978
1979        Examples:
1980            >>> Table(columns=["X", "Y"]).column_headers
1981            ['X', 'Y']
1982        """
